notes.text: November 11 – Time to start watching the weather forecast! As of Wednesday morning, the forecast calls for a mixed precipitation event Thursday and Friday with lots of uncertainty about the mix. There is a good chance we will get enough snow for photos to build excitement about the upcoming season. Not likely but possible case is around 8″ of snow, if we get this we might have a day or two of skiing before warm ground and the warmer temperatures forecast for next week melt it away.
Stats for the 2025-26 season: First ski day was November 30, last ski day was April 1. Total of 116 ski days, 103″ snow.
